subject.title: fix(nextcloud-talk): add timeouts to Talk send requests

question: Should Nextcloud Talk outbound message and reaction sends use a hard 30s default timeout, or should the plugin expose/reuse a configurable timeout policy before this PR merges?
rationale: The code fix is mechanically sound, but changing an unbounded send into a 30s failure changes upgrade behavior for unusually slow self-hosted Talk servers.

options.title: Accept 30s bounded failure
options.body: Merge the PR as-is and treat hung or very slow outbound Talk sends as failures after 30s.

options.title: Require plugin timeout policy
options.body: Ask for a plugin-owned timeout setting or documented policy if maintainers want operators to tune slow self-hosted sends.

recommendation.title: Accept 30s bounded failure
recommendation.body: Merge the PR as-is and treat hung or very slow outbound Talk sends as failures after 30s.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent blame and channel/private-network policy history make this the best available owner for the timeout-default tradeoff.
